runs.method: 32 warmup +96 sampled frames per case; persistent scene/UI assets; production draw/present/audio; linker wraps measure display acquisition, presentation and audio; no framebuffer dumps or per-frame logs.
runs.population: Generic map cases use the full authored NPC definition population. Mason/Sam use actual original opening VM states; Ronald is a controlled source-position lobby fixture.
runs.limits: Emulator CP0 timings include emulated RSP and host-backed RDP wait behavior; they are not physical-console FPS. Steady frame callbacks exclude controller polling/VM work outside rendering. Work subtracts only display_get acquisition/pacing wait.
